overall_reason: A plain deploy list ('Checkout redesign', 'Search speedup', 'Pricing copy') whose failed row hands its problem to a gradient 'Ask AI' pill instead of showing the failure.

score.reason: T-DEFAULT-AGENT and T-BOLD-MOVE fail on the 'Ask AI' pill, which outshouts the 'Deploy' button and replaces the failed row's timestamp; T-SIGNATURE passes only for the first row.

findings.title: No AI tech clichés
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the failed row shows a violet-to-pink 'Ask AI' pill with sparkle glyphs where the other rows show a time ('Just now', '12m ago'). The row gives no failure reason.
findings.before: 'Ask AI' gradient pill in place of the failure's facts.
findings.after: Show what failed and when ('Failed 1h ago', the failing step) with a plain 'View logs' action. [DATA NEEDED: the failure reason]
findings.why: A generic AI button stands in for the information a developer needs to fix the deploy.

findings.title: Spend boldness in one place
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png two elements shout: the black 'Deploy' button and the saturated gradient pill. The pill is the only saturated colour in the card.
findings.before: Two loud accents in a 300 px card.
findings.after: Keep 'Deploy' as the one loud element; set any secondary action in the row's neutral style.
findings.why: The eye goes to the AI pill before the primary action or the status icons.

strengths: The first row carries real detail ('main · Maya Chen', 'Just now') and a status icon per row.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
